1: // Simple "Cosmic Courier" game for a canvas with id="game"
2: // Ship, scrolling stars, crates, stations, asteroids, fuel & score.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10: 
11:   // ---- Game state ------------------------------------------------
12:   const state = {
13:     ship: { x: width / 2, y: height - 60, w: 30, h: 30, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 2, fuel: 100, lives: 3, hasCargo: false },
14:     stars: [],
15:     crates: [],
16:     stations: [],
17:     asteroids: [],
18:     score: 0,
19:     keys: {},
20:     lastSpawn: 0,
21:   };
22: 
23:   // ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------
24:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
25:   const rectCollide = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
26: 
27:   // ---- Initialize stars -----------------------------------------
28:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
29:     state.stars.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: rand(0, height), size: rand(0.5, 2), speed: rand(0.2, 0.6) });
30:   }
31: 
32:   // ---- Input -----------------------------------------------------
33:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => state.keys[e.key] = true);
34:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => state.keys[e.key] = false);
35: 
36:   // ---- Game loop -------------------------------------------------
37:   function update(dt) {
38:     // Move ship based on keys
39:     if (state.keys['ArrowLeft']) state.ship.vx = -state.ship.speed;
40:     else if (state.keys['ArrowRight']) state.ship.vx = state.ship.speed;
41:     else state.ship.vx = 0;
42:     if (state.keys['ArrowUp']) state.ship.vy = -state.ship.speed;
43:     else if (state.keys['ArrowDown']) state.ship.vy = state.ship.speed;
44:     else state.ship.vy = 0;
45: 
46:     state.ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - state.ship.w, state.ship.x + state.ship.vx));
47:     state.ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - state.ship.h, state.ship.y + state.ship.vy));
48: 
49:     // Fuel consumption
50:     state.ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt;
51:     if (state.ship.fuel <= 0) state.ship.fuel = 0;
52: 
53:     // Move stars for scrolling background
54:     for (const s of state.stars) {
55:       s.y += s.speed * dt * 0.1;
56:       if (s.y > height) { s.y = 0; s.x = rand(0, width); }
57:     }
58: 
59:     // Spawn crates, stations, asteroids periodically
60:     const now = performance.now();
61:     if (now - state.lastSpawn > 2000) {
62:       // crate
63:       state.crates.push({ x: rand(0, width - 20), y: -20, w: 20, h: 20, vy: 1.5 });
64:       // station (moves horizontally at top)
65:       const dir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
66:       state.stations.push({ x: dir === 1 ? -50 : width + 50, y: rand(30, 100), w: 60, h: 30, vx: dir * 0.5 });
67:       // asteroid
68:       state.asteroids.push({ x: rand(0, width - 30), y: -30, w: 30, h: 30, vy: 2 + Math.random() * 1 });
69:       state.lastSpawn = now;
70:     }
71: 
72:     // Update crates
73:     for (let i = state.crates.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
74:       const c = state.crates[i];
75:       c.y += c.vy * dt * 0.05;
76:       // collect
77:       if (!state.ship.hasCargo && rectCollide(state.ship, c)) {
78:         state.ship.hasCargo = true;
79:         state.crates.splice(i, 1);
80:         continue;
81:       }
82:       // out of screen
83:       if (c.y > height) state.crates.splice(i, 1);
84:     }
85: 
86:     // Update stations
87:     for (let i = state.stations.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
88:       const s = state.stations[i];
89:       s.x += s.vx * dt * 0.05;
90:       // wrap
91:       if (s.vx > 0 && s.x > width + 50) s.x = -50;
92:       if (s.vx < 0 && s.x < -50) s.x = width + 50;
93:       // drop cargo
94:       if (state.ship.hasCargo && rectCollide(state.ship, s)) {
95:         state.ship.hasCargo = false;
96:         state.ship.fuel = Math.min(100, state.ship.fuel + 10);
97:         state.score += 10;
98:       }
99:     }
100: 
101:     // Update asteroids
102:     for (let i = state.asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
103:       const a = state.asteroids[i];
104:       a.y += a.vy * dt * 0.05;
105:       if (rectCollide(state.ship, a)) {
106:         state.asteroids.splice(i, 1);
107:         state.ship.lives -= 1;
108:         if (state.ship.lives <= 0) {
109:           // game over
110:           alert('Game Over! Score: ' + state.score);
111:           document.location.reload();
112:           return;
113:         }
114:         continue;
115:       }
116:       if (a.y > height) state.asteroids.splice(i, 1);
117:     }
118: 
119:     // Fuel out -> game over
120:     if (state.ship.fuel <= 0) {
121:       alert('Out of fuel! Score: ' + state.score);
122:       document.location.reload();
123:       return;
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127:   function draw() {
128:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
129:     // stars
130:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
131:     for (const s of state.stars) ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
132:     // ship
133:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
134:     ctx.fillRect(state.ship.x, state.ship.y, state.ship.w, state.ship.h);
135:     // cargo indicator
136:     if (state.ship.hasCargo) {
137:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
138:       ctx.fillRect(state.ship.x + 5, state.ship.y - 10, 20, 5);
139:     }
140:     // crates
141:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
142:     for (const c of state.crates) ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
143:     // stations
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
145:     for (const s of state.stations) ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h);
146:     // asteroids
147:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
148:     for (const a of state.asteroids) ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h);
149:     // UI
150:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
151:     ctx.font = '14px monospace';
152:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + state.score, 10, 20);
153:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.round(state.ship.fuel), 10, 38);
154:     ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + state.ship.lives, 10, 56);
155:   }
156: 
157:   let last = performance.now();
158:   function loop(now) {
159:     const dt = now - last;
160:     last = now;
161:     update(dt);
162:     draw();
163:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164:   }
165:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
166: })();
